newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life up after results, Kleinwort "buy".
newsitem.headline: Sun Life up after results, Kleinwort "buy".

text.p: Shares in Sun Life & Provincial Plc rose in a strong insurance sector on Tuesday as analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson repeated a "buy" rating following year-end results, dealers said.
The stock was up 12p at 291-1/2 by 1018 GMT.

Sun Life, listed on the UK equity market last June, said operating profit rose three percent to 181.6 million stg despite a major increase in competition in life and pensions and an expected downturn in general insurance.

Chairman Lord Douro said the company was well placed for future growth, "with our prime focus firmly on profitability for our shareholders through the delivery of quality products and service to our customers."
Analysts at Kleinwort were not immediately available for comment.
